TBF Play-by-Play

Source: R/tbf.R
tbf_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play of a finished game (2025-26 onward), in game order, with the running score and an English gloss.

Endpoint: GET https://miniappapi.tbf.org.tr/webapi-service/api/Match/game-flow

Usage

tbf_pbp(match_id)

Arguments

match_id

Required. TBF game id (integer), e.g. 346279; match_id in tbf_schedule(). One global sequence across leagues and seasons. Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble. One row per event. Games before 2025-26 raise hoopR_no_data. The feed has no player id. Every column below is always present (a zero-row tibble keeps them and their types); an answer with nothing in it raises hoopR_no_data, as in sdv-py.

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerTBF game id (key space: TBF games, ONE global sequence across leagues and seasons: 62552 in 2006-07, 346279 in 2026-27). The match_id argument of every game wrapper; the routes echo it as a string or null, the runtime stamps the integer asked for.
action_numberintegerPlay sequence number (actionNumber); gaps are deleted or hidden actions. Rows are in the API's game order, and a period-end line can carry a LOWER number than the last play of the period (884 after 885 in the sample), so sort by period and clock, not by this number.
periodintegerPeriod number (quarterNumber): 1-4; overtime numbering is unverified.
period_typeintegerPeriod type code: 1 = regulation, 2 = overtime (from the app code; no overtime game in the samples).
clockcharacterGame clock REMAINING in the period as 'mm:ss' (counts down from 10:00).
seconds_remainingintegerGame clock remaining in the period, in seconds.
home_scoreintegerRunning home score after the play (the home half of the 'home-away' score text).
away_scoreintegerRunning away score after the play (the away half of the score text).
sidecharacterSide of the acting team (isHome); null on game events (period start / end, game end).
player_namecharacterActing player's name; null on game events. The feed carries no player id.
jersey_numbercharacterShirt number as a string, so '0' and '00' stay distinct.
actioncharacterPlay type in Turkish exactly as TBF sends it (77 values seen).
action_encharacterEnglish gloss of the Turkish action, from the refs action vocabulary; null for an action not in it.

Details

Official TBF app API, unofficial for SportsDataverse: the backend of the Turkish Basketball Federation's mobile app (miniappapi.tbf.org.tr), which serves BSL, TBL, KBSL and the other TBF leagues. It needs no key; robots.txt answers 404 on the host, and the runtime spaces requests at least 1 s apart. SportsDataverse has not ruled on TBF's terms, so payloads are not redistributed as release assets. The vendor's origin hosts (nikayazilim.com) serve the same data without Cloudflare but are deliberately not used, redirects are never followed, and www.tbf.org.tr's interactive Turnstile is neither used nor automated.

Coverage: season and competition are parameters (bsl Basketbol Super Ligi, back to 1966-67 in the league list; tbl second tier; kbsl women, both from 2015-16). Game wrappers serve FINISHED games only (an unfinished game raises hoopR_asset_fetch). Box scores exist from 2006-07 (no starters flagged that season); play-by-play and shots from 2025-26 only, an earlier finished game raises hoopR_no_data. Every game carries a Genius LiveStats id (genius_id, joins the genius family) from 2018-19 on some seasons and on every game of 2025-26 and later. Birth dates, contact details, photos and logos are dropped. Names and category labels are Turkish; the column descriptions give the English gloss.

Errors: hoopR_no_data when TBF has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, an unknown game or player, a season the league list lacks, an empty list, a finished game before 2025-26 asked for play-by-play or shots); hoopR_bad_request for an invalid argument or HTTP 400 / 422; hoopR_asset_fetch when the fetch failed or the answer is not the one asked for (an unfinished game, a body for another game, season, league or team, an error envelope, a redirect, a partial page or a changed capped list). All inherit hoopR_error. Timestamps are Turkey local time (Europe/Istanbul).
